rv.q: Its biggest obstacle is discovering its own identity, as right now it veers between two completely different tones that don’t complement each other at all, instead resulting in an uneven watch.
Ultimately, Nero can’t decide whether it is a biting political satire, a psychological tragedy, a crude vaudeville comedy or a no-holds-barred rock musical.
Whatever the answer may be, it surely cannot be Nero: A New Musical.

cn.t: Despite a talented cast and some strong songs, this ambitious musical about the Roman Emperor falters with muddled storytelling and misplaced melodrama that undermines its political satire.
